info.title: Web Tales API
info.description:
REST API for the **Web Tales** blogging platform. Provides user accounts,
email-based authentication with JWT, stories, AI generated summaries, and
categories.

## Authentication

Most endpoints require a JWT obtained from `POST /auth/login`.
Send it on every protected request as:

```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

Tokens expire per the `JWT_EXPIRES_IN` environment variable (default: 30 days).
When you see a 🔒 **lock** icon in Swagger UI, the endpoint requires this header.

## Error format

All errors share the same envelope:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "message": "User not found",
    "code": "NOT_FOUND",
    "details": { "userId": "..." }
  }
}
```

The optional `details` field is included for validation errors (as a list of
per-field issues) and for 5xx errors when `NODE_ENV=development`.

get.description:
Lightweight liveness/readiness probe used by load balancers and uptime monitors.
Returns `200` when both the API and the database are reachable, and `503`
when the database query fails.

post.description:
Creates a new user with the `USER` role, stores a bcrypt-hashed
password, and dispatches a verification email containing a
signed JWT confirmation token.

201.description: Account created. Email verification is pending.

example.message: Registration successful. Please confirm your email address.

409.description: Username or email is already in use.

post.summary: Log in and obtain a JWT
post.description:
Verifies credentials and returns a JWT signed with `JWT_SECRET`.
The token is also embeded inside `req.user.id` on subsequent requests.
Email must be verified before login succeeds.

400.description: Credentials are invalid or email is not verified.

get.description:
Consumes a one-time email-verification token (JWT with
`type: email-verification`) and marks the user's email as verified.

400.description: Token is missing, malformed, or expired.

post.description:
Re-sends the verification email if the account exists and the email is
not already verified. Always returns the same response to avoid leaking
which addresses are registered.

200.description: Acknowledgement. The email will only be sent when relevant.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of user accounts. Supports search,
pagination, and sorting. Requires the `ADMIN` role.
Returns a single user. Only the user themselves or an admin may read the record.

patch.description:
Admin or self-update of a user record. Changing the email triggers a
fresh verification flow.

409.description: Username or email conflicts with another user.

delete.description: Marks the user as deleted (the record is retained but hidden).

get.description: Returns the profile of the user whose token is presented.

patch.description:
Update your own username, name, or email. Changing the email triggers
a fresh verification email.

post.description:
Validates the current password and emails a one-time confirmation
token (15-minute TTL by default) to the user. Rate limited to
5 requests / 15 minutes per IP.

message.example: If your current password is correct, a confirmation link has been sent to your email.

post.description:
Consumes the email token and a new password. The new password must
differ from the current one. Rate limited to 10 requests / 15 minutes per IP.

Creates a new story owned by the requesting user (or by `userId`
if the caller is an admin). Categories must already exist.
Setting `generateSummary: true` asks the server to call the
Gemini AI summary endpoint.

example.body: It was a quiet evening in the repository when something started to drift...

get.description: Public listing of stories with pagination, search, sort, and an optional category filter.

data.title: The Curious Case of the Missing Semicolon
data.sumary: A detective story about a missing semi-colon in a JS repo.

get.description: Returns a single story by its UUID.

patch.description:
Updates a story. Caller must be the story owner or have the `ADMIN`
role. Pass any subset of fields; at least one is required.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a story. Caller must be the story owner or an admin.

post.summary: Generate (or regenerate) an AI summary for a story
post.description:
Calls the Gemini AI to produce a 2–3 sentence summary of the story body
and persists it. If the story already has a summary, pass
`?regenerate=true` to overwrite it. Rate limited to 5 requests / minute
per IP.

200.description: Story with the (possibly newly generated) summary.

post.description: Creates a new category. Admin only.

409.description: A category with this name already exists.

get.description: Returns every category in the system. Requires authentication.

patch.description: Updates a category's name and/or description. Admin only.

delete.description:
Removes a category. The endpoint currently returns a `404` for
unknown ids; the route handler is wired through `updateCategory`
which is a known bug in `category.controller.ts` that should be
reviewed alongside this change.

Role.description: Role assigned to a user account.

User.description: Public representation of a user account (no password).

AuthUser.description: User payload returned by the auth endpoints (login/signup).

Category.description: Category that can be attached to a story.

CategoryRef.description: Compact category reference embedded in a story.

PaginationMeta.description: Pagination metadata accompanying a list response.

total.description: Total number of records matching the query. Only returned when `count=true`.

PaginatedEnvelope.description: Standard envelope returned by list endpoints.

MessageResponse.description: Generic acknowledgement returned by mutating endpoints.

token.description: JWT access token. Pass it on subsequent requests via `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

message.example: Registration successful. Please confirm your email address.

Error.description: Error envelope returned for any non-2xx response.

details.description: Optional structured context (omitted in production for 5xx errors).

ValidationIssue.description: Single issue produced by request validation.

retryAfter.description: Seconds until the next request will be accepted.

EmailTokenPath.name: token
EmailTokenPath.description: Email verification token that was emailed to the user.

OffsetQuery.name: offset
OffsetQuery.description: Number of items to skip before returning results.

LimitQuery.name: limit
LimitQuery.description: Maximum number of items to return.

SearchQuery.name: search
SearchQuery.description: Case-insensitive search across relevant text fields.

CountQuery.name: count
CountQuery.description: When `true`, includes the `total` count in the response `meta`.

RegenerateQuery.name: regenerate
RegenerateQuery.description: Pass `true` to force regeneration of an existing summary.

RegisterRequest.description: Payload required to register a new account.

password.description: At least 8 characters, with upper, lower, and numeric characters.

LoginRequest.description: Email and password used to obtain a JWT.

InitiatePasswordChangeRequest.description: Send the current password to start the password-change flow.

ConfirmPasswordChangeRequest.description: Provide the emailed token together with the new password.

token.description: Token mailed to the user after initiating the change.

newPassword.description: Must differ from the previous password.

UpdateUserRequest.description: Partial update for an existing user (admin or self).

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Update the authenticated user's own profile.

userId.description: UUID of the user who owns the story. Admins may create stories for any user; regular users may only create for themselves.

bearerAuth.description:
JWT issued by `POST /auth/login`. Send it on protected endpoints using:

```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

Tokens expire according to the `JWT_EXPIRES_IN` environment variable (default: 30 days).
